mapper.select: SELECT identity_id, contact_id, identity_type, identity_value, source, is_primary, is_verified, create_time, update_time FROM crm_customer_identity WHERE identity_type = #{identityType} AND identity_value = #{identityValue}

SELECT identity_id, contact_id, identity_type, identity_value, source, is_primary, is_verified, create_time, update_time FROM crm_customer_identity WHERE contact_id = #{contactId} ORDER BY identity_type, identity_id

SELECT identity_id, contact_id, identity_type, identity_value, source, is_primary, is_verified, create_time, update_time FROM crm_customer_identity WHERE (identity_type, identity_value) IN
(#{q.identityType}, #{q.identityValue})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_customer_identity ( contact_id, identity_type, identity_value, source, is_primary, is_verified ) VALUES ( #{contactId}, #{identityType}, #{identityValue}, #{source}, COALESCE(#{isPrimary}, false), COALESCE(#{isVerified}, false) )

INSERT INTO crm_customer_identity ( contact_id, identity_type, identity_value, source, is_primary, is_verified ) VALUES ( #{contactId}, #{identityType}, #{identityValue}, #{source}, COALESCE(#{isPrimary}, false), COALESCE(#{isVerified}, false) ) ON CONFLICT (identity_type, identity_value) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_customer_identity SET is_primary = false, update_time = now() WHERE contact_id = #{contactId} AND is_primary = true
